title_zh: 青少年「失眠」可能是晝夜節律延遲：挪威研究近九成有相位後移指標
summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格整理挪威 3,867 名高中生的研究（Arnesen 等，2025）：34.5% 符合失眠標準，但其中 88.4% 呈現晝夜節律延遲的指標。作者建議評估上學日與假日的睡眠時間差、延後就寢是否改善入睡、週末補眠等；失眠以 CBT-I 處理，節律延遲則考慮光照、褪黑激素時機與逐步提前起床時間，而非只叫孩子早點上床。
summary_en: An ACAMH blog summarises a study of 3,867 Norwegian high-school students (Arnesen et al., 2025): 34.5% met insomnia criteria, yet 88.4% of these showed indicators of circadian delay. The author recommends assessing school-day vs free-day sleep timing, response to later bedtimes and weekend catch-up sleep; CBT-I for insomnia, and light, melatonin timing and gradual wake-time advances for circadian delay rather than simply earlier bedtimes.
evidence_note: 引用的原始研究為流行病學調查，部落格為臨床整理與建議，非介入試驗。

ethics_flags.note: 褪黑激素與光照治療涉及醫療判斷，心理師應與醫師合作或轉介，而非自行建議用藥。

caution: 部落格建議的褪黑激素與光照治療須經醫療評估；數據來自挪威樣本，本地青少年的情況可能不同。
brief_zh: 3,867 名挪威高中生；34.5% 符合失眠標準
符合者中 88.4% 有節律延遲指標
評估：上學日 vs 假日睡眠、睡眠日誌、週末補眠
勿只建議提早就寢，可能增加挫折
brief_en: 3,867 Norwegian high-school students; 34.5% met insomnia criteria
Assess school vs free days, sleep diaries, weekend catch-up sleep
Simply advising earlier bedtimes may increase frustration
supervision_questions: 初談時我們用哪些問題區分青少年的失眠與睡眠相位後移？
若是節律延遲，CBT-I 中哪些元素需要調整或可能適得其反？
與學校和家長溝通上學時間與睡眠節律時，可以怎麼說？

posts.title: When 'Insomnia' Is Not Insomnia: Understanding Circadian Delay in Adolescents
posts.content: ACAMH 部落格引用挪威 3,867 名高中生研究：34.5% 符合失眠標準，其中 88.4% 顯示晝夜節律延遲指標，提醒臨床人員區分失眠與睡眠相位後移，並列出評估與處理建議。

related.title_zh: 青少年自傷：把每次接觸服務變成照護機會——英國 544 名自殺身亡青少年資料
related.title_en: Youth self-harm and service contact before suicide
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介英國全國連續案例系列研究（Aggarwal 等，British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025）：544 名 10–19 歲自殺身亡者中 49% 有自傷紀錄、26% 有近期自傷；近期自傷者中 60% 在死亡前三個月內曾接觸心理健康服務，95% 經歷近期逆境。另有 51% 沒有自傷紀錄。作者建議評估不只看自傷行為，也要看關係、安全與環境壓力，並提供協調的個別化照護與 48 小時內的後續追蹤。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a UK consecutive case series (Aggarwal et al., British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025) of 544 young people aged 10–19 who died by suicide: 49% had a self-harm history and 26% recent self-harm; among those with recent self-harm, 60% had contact with mental health services in the prior three months and 95% had recent adversity, while 51% had no recorded self-harm. The author urges broader assessment of relationships, safety and stressors, coordinated care and 48-hour follow-up.

related.title_zh: Anna Freud 的校本 CBT 計畫 MindWorks 進入 30 間學校做 RCT
related.title_en: Anna Freud's MindWorks school CBT programme enters RCT
related.summary_zh: MindWorks 是 Anna Freud 開發、以系統取向為基礎的 CBT 計畫，對象為 11–16 歲學生，由受訓的教育心理健康從業員等在一個學期內提供，並把家長與學校職員納入。計畫由 Youth Endowment Fund 資助，2026 年 9 月起在英格蘭 30 間主流與另類學校推行，Ending Youth Violence Lab 以 720 名兒童進行隨機對照試驗。
related.summary_en: MindWorks, a systemic CBT programme for 11–16-year-olds developed by Anna Freud, launches in 30 English schools from September 2026 and is being evaluated in an RCT of 720 children by the Ending Youth Violence Lab.

related.title_zh: 焦慮家長的自助線上課程能預防孩子焦慮嗎？1,811 人 RCT 的小效果與低完成率
related.title_en: Online program for anxious parents prevents child anxiety
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介一項平行組隨機對照試驗（Dunn 等，2024）：1,811 名高焦慮家長（子女 2–11 歲）分為無人引導的線上模組組或控制組，模組每單元約 20 分鐘，涵蓋減少迴避、情緒教練、減少過度保護等。六個月時介入組子女的家長評焦慮顯著較低（d = −0.16），家長焦慮也下降；但約 32% 完成兩個以上模組、約 19% 全部完成。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a parallel-group RCT (Dunn et al., 2024) in which 1,811 highly anxious parents of children aged 2–11 were randomised to unguided online modules (about 20 minutes each, covering avoidance, emotion coaching, overprotection) or control. At six months, parent-reported child anxiety was significantly lower (d = −0.16) and parental anxiety also fell, but only about 32% completed two or more modules and about 19% completed all.
